ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a schematic diagram of the distribution of China's main cotton-producing provinces and regions and the changes in cotton planting area from 1980 to 2005. The location of Xinjiang in the northwest is marked with an obvious bar symbol indicating growth in cotton planting area, showing that Xinjiang is one of our country's important cotton regions. Then reason: the question asks about the advantageous conditions for Xinjiang's cotton having the best quality. Xinjiang is located in the inland northwest of our country, with an arid climate, many sunny days, little cloud cover, and strong solar radiation. Cotton growth and the formation of fiber quality require sufficient sunlight, so its advantageous condition is abundant sunlight.
